title: Private Baseball Lessons in Irvine, CA | MBM Baseball Training
description: 1-on-1 youth baseball lessons in Irvine — hitting, fielding, throwing, pitching, and mindset with Coach Myles. Free first lesson.
lead: Irvine is about 35 minutes south of our Long Beach home base, and it's one of Orange County's biggest youth-baseball markets — with the facilities and competition to match.
body: Few cities are built for youth baseball like Irvine. The Orange County Great Park sports complex alone runs ten lighted ball fields plus two stadiums, and three separate leagues — Irvine PONY, Irvine Ranch Little League, and Northwood Little League — keep thousands of kids playing. The flip side of all that talent is real competition, and that's where private coaching earns its keep.

Coach Myles coaches the complete game — hitting, fielding, throwing, pitching, and baseball IQ — and leads with mechanics and mindset: developing the right way as a young athlete and competing with confidence. Every session is true 1-on-1, at a field that works for your family.
If your player is pushing for a travel roster or a starting spot in a deep league, the free first lesson is a smart, no-pressure first step.

faq.q: Do you really travel to Irvine?
faq.a: Yes — Irvine is about 35 minutes from home base. For families that far out, longer or less-frequent sessions often make the most sense, and we'll find a rhythm that works.

faq.q: Which skills can you work on?
faq.a: All of them — hitting, fielding, throwing, pitching, and baseball IQ — tailored to your player and their league.
Book the free first lesson: a 30-minute evaluation and Q&A with Coach Myles, no obligation.
